items.title: NATIVE: a read of a container beside a live `&mut` view is rustc E0502 (`let v = &mut xs; xs.len(); v.push(3)`) though vilan allows it - the emitted Rust holds the view across the read
items.discussion: lane std-56 (Order 56): met building the entry idiom (M191) - vilan's view rule lets a container be READ while a view into it is live; Rust's borrow checker does not when the view is a `&mut` binding
items.body: Rec: the emitter re-derives the view after the read (NLL-friendly: emit the read before the `&mut` is taken when the analyzer can reorder, else take the view again), or the analyzer refuses the read on the native target with a steer. Pin on the native differential. Sizing S-M.

items.title: A `let` view is live until the END of its scope, not its last use: `let s = map.slot(k); s.take(); map.insert(..)` is refused after `s`'s last use
items.discussion: lane std-56 (Order 56): the stored-view rule refuses a mutation while a view binding is live; liveness is scope-based where the LastUse tables already know the last use
items.body: Rec: end a view binding's liveness at its last use (the LastUse record exists for this), so the M191 idiom composes with a following insert; pin both the accepted shape and the refusal when the view IS used after. Sizing S.

items.title: `match &mut map.slot(k) { Some(let h) => h.1 += 1 }` is refused with "cannot mutate immutable" - a `&mut` match over a view's `Some` binds its payload immutably
items.discussion: lane std-56 (Order 56): the M191 entry idiom's hand-written form; `get_or_insert` sidesteps it
items.body: A `match &mut <view>` should bind each arm's payload as a mutable view (as `match &mut` over a place does). Pin the tuple-payload write and a field write. Sizing S.

items.title:
A `context` clause on an impl METHOD is unsupported - B696 had to rely on the inferred requirement (`on_cleanup`) instead of writing `fun assume(self): Store

context owner_scope`
items.discussion: lane std-56 (Order 56): the ruled B696 spelling could not be written; the inferred form gives the same refusal with a longer trace
items.body: Allow the clause on inherent and trait impl methods (the hidden-parameter threading as for free functions and closure parameters, B677 door 2); spec contexts.md; pins. Sizing S-M.

items.title: The JS `HashSet` reads x1.25 instructions on 1M inserts+contains after M191: the table is a `[map, pending]` pair, one more indirection per call - keep the pending mark on the `Map` itself
items.discussion: lane std-56 (Order 56): the other M191 rows are x0.94-x1.01 on JS; the interpreter would need to carry the mark too
items.body: Rec: a private property on the `Map` (or a `Symbol`-keyed slot) for the pending mark; the const interpreter mirrors it; re-measure the four M191 rows. Sizing S.
